Package com.csse3200.game.components.player

Class GamblingCatalogs

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.player.GamblingCatalogs
public class GamblingCatalogs extends Object
Standard and Premium spin catalogs held by the player's ShopComponent.

Not a Component and not a wallet. Each catalog stores a spin price and five weighted prizes. Later probability for a slot is weight / sum(weights in that catalog). This class stores weights and does not compute or roll them; see GamblingRoller.

A prize product is a GamblingCatalogs.Prize: GamblingCatalogs.ItemPrize, GamblingCatalogs.GoldPrize, ShopComponent.Pet, or ShopComponent.Upgrade.
